description: This file defines the ByteArray class, a utility class for handling byte arrays with various methods for encoding, comparison, bitwise operations, and conversion, used within AWS SDK cryptography components.

classes.name: ByteArray
classes.description: A class extending SplFixedArray to provide byte array operations such as encoding, comparison, XOR, incrementing, shifting, and slicing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes ByteArray from integer, string, array, or another ByteArray, converting input to a byte array.

methods.name: enc32be
methods.description: Encodes a 32-bit unsigned integer into a ByteArray in big-endian order.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this ByteArray is equal to another ByteArray.

methods.name: exclusiveOr
methods.description: Performs a bitwise XOR with another ByteArray of the same size.

methods.name: getIncremented
methods.description: Returns a new ByteArray incremented by a specified value.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets a value at a specific index, masking to 8 bits.

methods.name: rshift
methods.description: Returns a new ByteArray shifted right by one bit.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Constant-time selection between two ByteArrays based on a selector.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Overwrites part of the ByteArray with another ByteArray starting at a given offset.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Returns a slice of the ByteArray.

methods.name: zeroize
methods.description: Sets all bytes in the ByteArray to zero.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts the ByteArray to a raw binary string.
